fusions.name: Snared Shriek
fusions.desc: Looses a piercing scream 5 tiles ahead of you that deals 12 resonating damage to everything in it, stuns them for 1 second and leaves them [Muddled] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Skipping Pulse
fusions.desc: Sends out a pulse of sound that deals 4 resonating damage to the first enemy it meets, then hops to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 60% of that. Each hit has a 40% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Erratic Flit
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% and your dodge chance by 8% for 8 seconds, and flits you 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Crepuscular Habit
fusions.desc: At night, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
